about: Everything a person needs to run the one tree from the first minute: the three workflows, the lists they write to with example rows, a worked example, and how to pour the example rows into lists the person already has.

definition.about: Each comment worth answering with a video: the words as written, where it was said, the video made and how it did.

fields.label: Why it is worth a video

definition.label: Comment leads

definition.about: Every branch of the one tree as a row: which workflow it runs, when it fires, how many agents, whether its work is public or internal by default. Adding a branch is adding a row.
definition.label: Tree branches

definition.about: References only, one row per output of the one tree: the id of the row that holds it, the branch that made it, the seed, and the branches that reuse it. The output itself stays in its own list; nothing is copied here.
definition.label: Tree outputs

definition.about: When each branch of the one tree fires, as conditions the engine evaluates: one row per condition, {fields, tree} for tool:filter-rows-by-rules over one typed part of a seed (kinds, subjects, people, niches as tags; own_words true or false). A branch fires for a part when any of its On condition rows keeps it. label keeps the words the condition was made from (the branch's fires_when, or the AI's judgment); made_by says which. When no condition keeps a part, the AI judges the branches' fires_when and writes its judgment back here as a new row, so the next such part is chosen by the engine. Adding a condition is adding a row.
definition.label: Tree branch conditions

accounts.why: Its viewers ask the questions my audience asks.

what_happens: A signal-sources row for the channel is written with watching Yes.
tool:watch-my-sources keeps each new video as a signals row (the first read is a quiet baseline).
tool:keep-channels-latest-videos-and-captions keeps captions and the top comments by kind (question, disagreement, newest).
Each comment worth a video becomes a comment-leads row with the words as written.
workflow:make-one-piece-of-content-from-audience-to-publish makes the video with the comment as the audience evidence.
The reply with the video link goes out after the person's yes (Instagram) or waits as reply-ready (other platforms).

pour_into_my_list: Each example row is a complete row of its list. To use a list you already keep instead, write the row's values into the fields of your list that mean the same (branch, workflow, fires_when, agents, visibility_default, state) with records:write at @own-records, and tell the workflow your list by id.
check: The recipes in recipes/workflows.json for these three ids pass recipeProblems with no tool gaps.
waiting_to_publish_why: Written in the account on 2026-11-12 by the inbox lane and not yet published to the Workshop; the email branch runs it once it is.
modes_are_selectors: The generic mode workflows (quintillion, infinity, real-life-cases, trillion-x-mode, first-win, follow-through, keep-it-working, make-it-perform, put-it-in-the-world, personalized-reach-out) stay the selectors. Branch rows point at their workflow ids; no second registry. Five mode steps gained one pointer sentence each: real-life-cases--case, quintillion--compose, infinity--bottleneck, infinity--continue, personalized-reach-out--follow.
one_use_of_the_tree: The content tree is one use of the tree, branches and leaves structure the person named for their gauntlet and decision method; the branch rows are its leaves.
views: Table = the lists; task = the tree's calendar-task rows; canvas = the existing workflow canvas of the recipe. Nothing new is built for them.

workflow:answer-commenters-with-videos: keep-posts-and-comments (with the treg fallback on refusal)
keep-posts-and-comments: tool:read-youtube-comments is the first route for YouTube comments, harvest tool then treg after
workflow:grow-the-one-tree: write-in-the-voice: the outline path (hook, talking points, outro in his own words) beside the full script and the voice-clone path
learn-and-prune: daily retraining of the writing on his edits and results
plant-the-seed: a record wake's changed rows are the seeds when no seed is given

choose-branches: typed parts (kinds, subjects, people, niches, own_words); the engine chooses through list tree-branch-conditions with tool:filter-rows-by-rules; the AI judges only parts no condition keeps and writes its judgment back as a condition row
fan-out: agents_per_step passed on to every branch run; a blocked branch heals into a new branch row and condition row in the same pass
learn-and-prune: learnings as new rows; prune only on three measured failures

cut_as_restating_a_mode_step: grow-the-one-tree--show (names existing views; moved to views)
library_rows: a library reference on turning a voice note into an outline
a library reference on offering a free tool to everyone who comments a keyword
pilot: Published with one wake, daily (start_at learn-and-prune), the continuation infinity's continue step names; like every Workshop wake it is off until the person switches it on (wake:switch). A person starts the tree from new rows of any list of theirs with a wake-declaration in their own records naming workflow:grow-the-one-tree, on {record: {resource: own-records, prefix: <that list's row id prefix>}}, input {start_at: plant-the-seed, owner, visibility}; plant-the-seed makes each row the cause names a seed. The decision verdict is recorded (GO, 2026-11-13).
agents: One number per step or branch: the row's agents is the default (a step row of any recipe, a branch row of list tree-branches) and the run's input agents_per_step under that id overrides it for the run (read-data/step-agents.mjs runStep). The trunk passes agents_per_step on to each branch run, so one map sets the width of the whole tree.
